items.title: Library supplement: The actual Gaussian Hermite class

source.anchor: F2 in source-only.json; proof topology P3.
source.attribution: Original generic exposition of Gaussian polynomial and finite Hermite features; existing proofs reused without a novelty or primary-textbook completion claim.

items.statement: Let \(E\) be a finite-dimensional real inner-product normed space with its Borel structure, and let \(\gamma_E=\operatorname{stdGaussian}(E)\) be the centered identity-covariance Gaussian probability. For each natural degree \(j\) and ambient vector \(w\), define the actual Gaussian \(L^2\) class of \(H_j(\langle w,\cdot\rangle)\). Here \(H_j\) is the unnormalized probabilists Hermite polynomial. Its integer coefficients are mapped canonically to the reals, and the proved polynomial membership witness forms the quotient class.
assumptions: The finite-dimensional real inner-product and Borel structures are the actual structures on the same carrier \(E\).
\(\gamma_E\) is the centered identity-covariance Gaussian probability. No positive dimension restriction is imposed.
\(j\in\mathbb N\) and \(w\in E\) are arbitrary. This defines a class; pointwise values of its chosen representative are not specified.

bindings.boundary: These are finite polynomial and actual Gaussian Hilbert-space results. Infinite-series limits and application-specific force identities require separate proofs.

assumption_deltas.source: E is a finite-dimensional real inner-product normed space with its Borel measurable structure; gamma_E is the centered identity-covariance Gaussian probability. H_j is the unnormalized probabilists Hermite polynomial, with Gaussian squared norm j!. L2 means the actual real square-integrable equivalence-class Hilbert space.
assumption_deltas.lean: Concrete finite-dimensional real inner-product normed and Borel structures on E, stdGaussian E and Lp real 2.
assumption_deltas.reason: The actual carrier and measure are preserved; no positive-dimension premise is introduced.

assumption_deltas.source: For every natural degree j and ambient vector w, take the L2 class of the literal probabilists Hermite polynomial H_j(<w,x>) under gamma_E. The definition uses the proved polynomial ridge membership witness and the real coefficient image of the integer Hermite polynomial. This is an actual equivalence class, not an arbitrary feature with assumed Gram identity.
assumption_deltas.lean: The exact compiled interface and its literal defining context, independently reconstructed.
assumption_deltas.reason: The seven-slot stage audit checks this exact statement, including ambient versus unit-vector domains and actual a.e. representatives.
